gap.behavioural_impact: In a period format the modern card lets 'Neo Space Pathfinder' serve as one of the five Fusion Materials - including as the required 'Neos' member - and lets it be banished from the Graveyard for the +500 ATK and the effect copy, none of which the Edison-era text permitted.

review.notes:
The pinned cards.cdb text matches v1 exactly (ratio 1.0); there is no later English version. 'remove from play' to 'banish', the PSCT semicolon, and 'It also gains the removed monster's effect(s), until the End Phase' to 'until the End Phase it also gains the banished monster's effects' are cosmetic. HERO-umbrella inertness verified against data/pools/edison-2010.json plus BabelCDB setcodes (all 77 pool HERO monsters are Elemental/Destiny/Evil HERO); the 'Neo Space' widening is the part that is NOT inert, because BabelCDB collapses 'Neos' and 'Neo Space' into setcode 0x9 so the modern script cannot distinguish them. Additional upstream divergence noted for whoever writes the historical script, not the basis of this decision: official/c31111109.lua's s.copycost searches LOCATION_MZONE|LOCATION_GRAVE, so it can banish a qualifying monster you control on the field, which neither the era nor the modern printed text ('from your Graveyard') allows.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Elemental HERO Divine Neos). No period ruling in the corpus settles a claimed difference, so the functional call stands unchanged (`unresolved` at both snapshots); the search is recorded in the check. Verdicts: [event] d1 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu; d2 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu; d3 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of Legendary Collection 2: The Duel Academy Years Mega Pack (LCGX-EN077), the only printing carrying the errata'd text

event.historical_text: This card cannot be Special Summoned except by a Fusion Summon of any 5 "Neos", "Neo-Spacian", "Elemental Hero", "Destiny Hero" or "Evil Hero" monsters including at least 1 "Neos" monster, 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster and 1 "Hero" monster. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 "Neos", "Neo-Spacian", "Elemental Hero", "Destiny Hero" or "Evil Hero" monster from your Graveyard to have this card gain 500 ATK. It also gains the removed monster's effect(s), until the End Phase.
event.modern_text: Must be Fusion Summoned using any 5 "Neos", "Neo Space", "Neo-Spacian", or "HERO" monsters, including at least 1 "Neos" or "Neo Space" monster, 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster, and 1 "HERO" monster, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Neos", "Neo Space", "Neo-Spacian", or "HERO" monster from your Graveyard; this card gains 500 ATK, and until the End Phase it also gains the banished monster's effects.
event.summary: The erratum widened both the Fusion Material list and the banish cost by adding '"Neo Space"' monsters, and widened the required 'at least 1 "Neos" monster' slot to 'at least 1 "Neos" or "Neo Space" monster'; the era text (CSOC-EN093) admits only 'Neos', 'Neo-Spacian', 'Elemental Hero', 'Destiny Hero' and 'Evil Hero' monsters. This is reachable inside the Edison pool: 'Neo Space Pathfinder' (TAEV-EN032, released 2007-08-15) is a 'Neo Space' monster, and BabelCDB gives it setcode 0x9 (SET_NEOS), so official/c31111109.lua's s.ffilter and s.costfilter accept it where the era card did not. Folding the three named HERO archetypes into 'HERO' is inert for period play, and the summon restriction stays strict (c:AddMustBeFusionSummoned()).

rulings_check.difference: The modern Fusion Material list accepts 'Neo Space' monsters (for example Neo Space Pathfinder); the era list only 'Neos', 'Neo-Spacian', 'Elemental Hero', 'Destiny Hero' and 'Evil Hero' monsters. The modern required 'at least 1 "Neos" or "Neo Space" monster' slot lets a Neo Space monster fill it; the era 'Neos' slot does not. The modern banish cost accepts a 'Neo Space' monster from the Graveyard; the era cost does not.
